oracle.scope: The real environment command preserves unknown CPU/memory/storage observations despite large selected work targets. A supplied observed address-space ceiling remains separately qualified and unchanged; neither a target nor unknown quota implies available capacity or proven impossibility. R rejects contradictory, unqualified, negative/noninteger or non-UTF-8 host claims as usage errors without changing caller observations or converting uncertainty into capacity. C retains these same behavioral oracles and public machine contracts while separating the internal option and semantic-constraint types.
